stories.title: Sheetal Devi receives Hyundai BAYON as brand ambassador
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India has presented a BAYON to world No. 1 para archer Sheetal Devi. The company described the gift as a token of appreciation for her sporting accomplishments and her role in promoting inclusion. Devi is a Paralympic medalist who shoots with her feet.

stories.title: Sachin Tendulkar fronts Sugarfit campaign
stories.summary: Sugarfit has launched a campaign featuring Sachin Tendulkar to encourage Indians to address unhealthy habits like late dinners and excessive sugar consumption. The brand says the initiative aims to help people take ownership of their metabolic health. The campaign line is be the Sugarfit Meany today.

stories.title: Licious targets choosy meat buyers in new campaign
stories.summary: Licious has launched a campaign titled Choosy Logon Ki Choice to highlight its range of meat and seafood products. The films focus on the company's 0 to 4 degree cold chain and 30-minute delivery service. The brand says choice is a product differentiator in the category.

stories.title: Deccan Herald and Prajavani release fifth cookery season
stories.summary: Deccan Herald and Prajavani have released the fifth season of their Cuisines of Karnataka video series. The 15-episode production features regional recipes from across the state, demonstrated by local chefs. The series is presented by LG Compounded Hing and powered by Freedom.

stories.title: Wacoal names Rakul Preet Singh brand ambassador
stories.summary: Wacoal has appointed Rakul Preet Singh as its brand ambassador in India. The partnership debuts with the Autumn and Winter 2026 campaign titled In Pursuit of Beauty. The company says the association brings together Japanese craftsmanship with the actor's style and sensibility.

Sachin Tendulkar discourages unhealthy habits in Sugarfit ads
stories.summary: Sugarfit has released a campaign featuring Sachin Tendulkar to address metabolic health. The ads show the cricketer intervening in daily routines to discourage late-night snacking and sedentary behavior. The company says the campaign uses humor to draw attention to habits that many Indians have normalized.

stories.title: Hyundai gifts BAYON to para archer Sheetal Devi
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India has presented a BAYON to its brand ambassador Sheetal Devi. The company cited her international para-archery achievements and her work with its inclusion initiative as reasons for the gift. Devi has won a Paralympic medal and multiple Asian Para Games awards.

stories.title: ET Shark Awards South 2026 winners announced
stories.summary: Digitally Inspired Media, Eastern, and Surf Excel were among the winners at the second edition of the ET Shark Awards South. Digitally Inspired Media was named Agency of the Year for the region. The awards recognize marketing and advertising campaigns judged by industry experts.

stories.title: Demand generation agencies evolve in India
stories.summary: India's digital marketing industry is shifting toward demand generation programs that combine data analytics and marketing automation. Businesses are increasingly prioritizing measurable revenue growth and customer acquisition over traditional advertising. The approach aims to stimulate interest and nurture potential customers throughout the buying journey.

stories.title: India media agency market records $1.2 billion in pitch activity
stories.summary: India's media agency market saw $1.2 billion in media spend linked to 131 account pitches during the first nine months of 2026. According to COMvergence, 107 of these were local pitches. The figure represents the estimated annual media spend associated with the accounts involved.

stories.title: Dentsu reports net billing loss of $464 million
stories.summary: Dentsu recorded a net billing loss of $464 million in the first nine months of 2026. While the group saw $1.14 billion in new business, losses totaled $2.652 billion. The company says media business is increasingly shifting toward group-level mandates rather than individual agency brands.

stories.title: Havas Media Network reports $149 million net billing loss
stories.summary: Havas Media Network recorded a net billing loss of $149 million during the first nine months of 2026. The agency saw $773 million in new business wins against $977 million in lost accounts. The industry is seeing a shift toward holding groups securing client mandates directly.

stories.title: Omnicom Media reports $4.79 billion in net new business
stories.summary: Omnicom Media recorded $4.79 billion in net new business during the first nine months of 2026. The network's performance included $5.17 billion in new wins and $3.72 billion in retained accounts. Group-level wins for clients like IBM and Subway accounted for 32 percent of acquisitions.

stories.title: WPP Media reports $1.72 billion in net new billings
stories.summary: WPP Media secured $1.72 billion in net new billings during the first nine months of 2026. The group recorded $4.22 billion in lost billings, the highest volume among the five major media groups. WPP says business is increasingly won through group-level solutions rather than individual brands.

stories.title: Publicis Media leads global new business rankings
stories.summary: Publicis Media recorded $6.19 billion in net new business during the first nine months of 2026. The group generated $7.18 billion in total new business value, driven by $7.256 billion in wins against $1.066 billion in losses. It currently leads the other four major agency groups.

stories.title: Ogilvy named global agency of record for Veet
stories.summary: Ogilvy has been appointed global agency of record for the hair removal brand Veet. The mandate covers advertising, social media, and influencer campaigns. The brand appointed the agency directly following a competitive pitch process, with Ogilvy UK leading the account.

stories.title: Filmmaker uses fake influencer to promote horror short
stories.summary: Jordan Wippell created a fake TikTok persona, Mom2TheMax, to promote his horror film OBEY!. The profile featured repurposed clips to build engagement, eventually garnering over 6.5 million views across social platforms. The filmmaker noted he was unprepared for what audiences were willing to believe.

stories.title: Influencer records goodbye video before death
stories.summary: Influencer Christie Miller died Monday following a battle with stage 4 breast cancer. She shared a pre-recorded video on her Instagram account announcing her own death to her followers. The message encouraged her audience to grieve but also to continue living their lives.

stories.title: AI personas are copying creators and reshaping beauty standards
stories.summary: A McGill University report identified nearly 300 accounts using hijacked faces and voices to spread political disinformation. Meanwhile, McKinsey projects AI could disrupt 36 million U.S. jobs by 2035. Instagram now requires mandatory disclosure for AI-generated profiles to throttle the reach of synthetic personas.

stories.title: Influencer announces her own death in pre-recorded message
stories.summary: Christie Miller, who documented her stage four breast cancer journey, released a pre-recorded video announcing her death. The 60-year-old told followers she had crossed the veil and was feeling no regret. She encouraged her audience to be sad but also happy for the life she lived.

stories.title: Influencer hits back at Kemi Badenoch over No 10 video criticism
stories.summary: Max Balegde, who filmed a video outside Downing Street, criticized Kemi Badenoch for calling his content a vile video. Balegde questioned her focus on the clip while dismissing concerns about the economy. The exchange followed a reception for online celebrities held at No 10.

stories.title: Meta prompts Instagram users to use Muse for saved posts
stories.summary: Meta is prompting users in the U.S. and Canada to use its ad-free AI assistant, Muse, to organize saved posts. The company plans to charge businesses a fee on purchases completed through the assistant. Meta says easier access to saved products helps advertisers drive more sales.

stories.title: YouTube adds music generation and comment moderation tools
stories.summary: YouTube is testing a feature that allows creators to generate royalty-free instrumental tracks to replace copyrighted audio. The platform is also testing a bulk moderation tool for comments. The music generation feature is currently available to U.S. desktop users with plans for further expansion.

stories.title: Meta launches AI ad tools with in-chat checkout
stories.summary: Meta announced a suite of AI-powered advertising tools at Advertising Week 2026. The updates include enhanced memory for its business assistant, which can now access historical campaign data and brand voice guidelines. The company is also testing scheduled tasks for automated performance reporting.

stories.title: Magister adds ChatGPT ads management to platform
stories.summary: Magister Marketing now supports ChatGPT Ads, allowing teams to manage, report on, and pause advertisements shown within ChatGPT conversations. The platform requires approval before any spend occurs. ChatGPT Ads are currently targeted by country and appear as traffic or conversion ads within the chat interface.

stories.title: Head of PM's influencer team quits after investigation
stories.summary: Ed Bearryman, the senior civil servant behind Andy Burnham's influencer videos, has stepped down. An investigation upheld an allegation of serious misconduct regarding unwanted contact with a younger colleague. The government's social media bill is currently projected to cost 25 million pounds.

stories.title: Amazon and Meta discuss Muse shopping access
stories.summary: Amazon and Meta are reportedly negotiating a potential arrangement to allow Meta's Muse AI agent to shop on Amazon. The discussions involve how product search and advertising would function if access is restored. No agreement or launch date has been announced by either company.

stories.title: Martech stacks struggle to distinguish humans from machines
stories.summary: Marketing technology has long operated on the assumption that website visitors are people. Analytics platforms count sessions and attribution models track human behaviour. As machines increasingly perform tasks once handled by customers, most existing martech stacks remain designed to discard this traffic. The machines are not visiting for the content.

stories.title: OtterlyAI launches ChatGPT plugin for search analytics
stories.summary: OtterlyAI has launched a ChatGPT plugin for its search analytics platform. Marketing teams can now query their AI search performance and agent traffic data in plain language. The service tracks AI search engines including Bing AI Mode and Grok. The data is now as conversational as the search engines.

Marketers prioritize human content and AI optimization for 2027
stories.summary: A Brandwatch report finds 71 percent of marketers expect human-first content to define 2027, while 59 percent plan to optimize for AI systems. Conversations regarding AI-generated ads rose 240 percent over the past year. Brands are now tasked with creating work people value while ensuring machines can find it.

stories.title: LG Ad Solutions adds DoubleVerify to home screen inventory
stories.summary: LG Ad Solutions is the first OEM to offer DoubleVerify fraud and invalid traffic verification for its home screen ad inventory. The global rollout allows advertisers to apply standard verification metrics to native IAB formats. Advertisers now have a new place to check if their ads are being seen.

stories.title: FMCG brand consistency remains a challenge
stories.summary: The UK FMCG market is projected to reach $394.5 billion by 2033, growing at 5.04 percent annually according to Kaizen Loyalty. As competition increases, brands are struggling to maintain a consistent image across marketing channels. The industry remains fast-paced, though the branding is expected to stay the same.

stories.title: Pine Labs introduces AI agents for merchant sales insights
stories.summary: Pine Labs has launched two AI agents, Guide and Marketer Agent, to assist small businesses with transaction analysis and ad campaign management. The tools allow merchants to access data via a conversational interface and automate Google ad creation. Merchants retain final approval before any advertising expenditure is actually committed.

stories.title: Dubai Safari Park increases India marketing budget
stories.summary: Dubai Safari Park has increased its India marketing investment by 20 percent following an 8 percent year-on-year rise in bookings. The park is currently seeking a Bollywood brand ambassador to expand its consumer base. India currently accounts for 20 percent of the park's B2B business.

stories.title: LinkedIn shifts AI focus toward advertising infrastructure
stories.summary: LinkedIn is integrating AI into its advertising infrastructure to improve campaign verification and audience authenticity. The platform aims to address advertiser concerns regarding environment suitability and meaningful results alongside standard targeting. The goal is to make the infrastructure as efficient as the algorithms that spend the money.
